itens.trecho: Obviously not as good as its predecessor, but I had a fun time with 'Kronk’s New Groove' . Like with 'The Emperor’s New Groove' , all the goodness comes with the humour which is again amusing. David Spade (Kuzco), who only appears for short cameos here, is definitely missed but Patrick Warburton (Kronk) does a respectable job at leading this sequel.
